answer: The wander holds work receipts rather than names, so the atlas of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on time-locked work history, diluted when peers disagree, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. By the ledge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
